selection.strategy: next 10 municipalities after Dantumadiel; second-layer deep search applied to previously open municipalities

findings: Huisvestingsverordening Regio Utrecht 2024, gemeente De Bilt is current from 16 September 2025.
Opkoopbescherming applies throughout the municipality to qualifying existing dwellings; the published price ceiling as of 9 September 2025 is €611,000 and is indexed annually.
The protected period is four years after registration of the deed and the regulation contains statutory permit grounds and exclusions.
Tourist-rental provisions in this regulation are explicitly not applicable.
The current Volkshuisvestingsprogramma 2024-2028 expressly announces a policy route to relax dwelling splitting subject to a healthy living environment and no disproportionate adverse effects.
The current Omgevingsplan gemeente De Fryske Marren is in force from 7 April 2025.
A separate current Beleidsregel woningsplitsing was not positively established in this deep-search pass, so the programme statement is treated as policy intent rather than sufficient permit criteria.
Address-level omgevingsplan review and successor-policy discovery remain required before definitive product rules are encoded.
Huisvestingsverordening Regio Utrecht 2024, gemeente De Ronde Venen contains a current kadastrale splitsingsvergunning regime for designated rental and purchase housing.
Leefbaarheidstoets 2023 remains current and expressly provides additional conditions for woningomzetting (verkamering) and woningsplitsing under the regional housing regulation.
The current Woonvisie 2025-2030 confirms that woningdelen and woningsplitsen remain active municipal housing topics.
The municipality therefore cannot be treated as having no housing-stock regulation; exact thresholds and address/use applicability require article-level and omgevingsplan assessment.
Beleidsregel voor woningsplitsing binnen de bebouwde kom De Wolden is current from 2 June 2022 through present.
It applies to applications for an omgevingsvergunning for dwelling splitting within the built-up area.

Each new dwelling must have at least 55 m2 usable floor area and the policy requires, among other things, parking on own land, no disproportionate impact on spatial/urban/cultural-historic quality and consistency with housing-stock policy.
This policy does not by itself establish a current opkoopbescherming or general room-rental regime, so those topics remain separately reviewable.
Delft remains queued for separate city-level deep review because partial search evidence is insufficient for safe encoding.
The deep review must consolidate current housing allocation, housing-stock changes, room/tourist rental where applicable and omgevingsplan interaction before product rules are created.
Huisvestingsverordening 2026 Den Helder is current from 24 January 2026 and explicitly replaces the 2015 regulation.
The old 2015 regulation expired on 24 January 2026 and must not be used for current answers.
The current regulation contains a specific mapped scope under Chapter 2A, so address-level protected-area resolution is required where that chapter applies.
The Omgevingsplan gemeente Deurne is current from 26 May 2025 and is the primary spatial framework for address-level residential-use questions.

Regeling Kavelsplitsing en incidentele woningbouw gemeente Deurne remains formally current, but it concerns parcel splitting/new housing and should not be conflated with splitting an existing dwelling into multiple residential units.
A prior room-rental-related social-assistance policy expired in 2023 and is explicitly rejected as evidence for current housing-use legality.

A sufficiently specific current general room-rental or housing-stock ordinance was still not established, so that topic remains open for targeted municipal/omgevingsplan review rather than being assumed absent.
Huisvestingsverordening Deventer 2026 is current from 7 February 2026 through 6 February 2030.
Chapter 4 contains opkoopbescherming with a four-year protected period for qualifying housing.
The regulation contains permit content, statutory permit grounds, withdrawal rules and links compliance to the Wet goed verhuurderschap.
Huisvestingsverordening Diemen 2026 is current from 1 July 2026.
The regulation contains distinct tourist-rental/short-stay and opkoopbescherming regimes.
Opkoopbescherming lasts four years and currently covers qualifying cheap and mid-priced dwellings within the regulation's stated WOZ bands.
Because multiple regimes interact, Diemen remains queued for article-level deep review before definitive product encoding.
Huisvestingsverordening Dijk en Waard 2023-2027 is current from 1 July 2023 through 30 June 2027.
The regulation contains a house-permit system for designated rental housing and therefore must be included in current 2026 answers.
This confirmed regulation is primarily allocation-focused; room rental, splitting and other spatial-use changes still require separate current omgevingsplan or policy review.
